_meta.description: Universal design tokens for all brand materials: website, dashboard, Instagram, ads, print

rules: Wine Red (#8C1C1C) is accent only — never fill full background
Amber Gold (#C9A84C) only for glass highlights, premium labels, prices
Dark mode default for hero product visuals; light mode for lifestyle and multi-glass scenes

typography.headingStyle: Bebas Neue Regular UPPERCASE — brand voice, power, confidence. Display sizes only (≥48px). Max 4-5 words.
typography.bodyStyle: Inter Regular — neutral, readable. All body copy, captions, labels, data.
typography.accentStyle: DM Sans Bold/SemiBold — human voice, warm, urban. Post headlines, subheadings, card titles.
rules: Never combine all 3 fonts in one layout
Bebas Neue: UPPERCASE only, max 4-5 words, never for sentences
No center-align for text longer than 2 lines
Minimum 16px for light text on dark background

layout.contentPosition: text left or top, visual right or background
layout.headerStyle: W&W monogram left (channel_avatar_light/dark — wordmark PNGs deprecated 2026-05-26), minimal nav right, no heavy chrome
layout.footerStyle: multi-column links, brand name bottom-left, muted text

atmosphere.mood: editorial wine bar — cinematic dark or alive light, never sterile, never loud
effects: hard directional light casting geometric shadows (light mode)
single warm key light 45° for product isolation (dark mode)
shallow depth of field on hero objects
condensation on glass in detail shots
gradients: none in dark mode — pure matte black
none in light mode — clean stone/marble texture carries the mood

dark.when: hero product, new arrival, price, action moment

light.when: bar atmosphere, multi-glass, hands, lifestyle scenes
light.background: light stone/travertine, white/grey marble, light linen
light.light: hard directional daylight at 30–45°, long geometric shadows
light.shadows: sharp, geometric from glass stems — SIGNATURE visual element
light.liquid: red, rosé, white, orange — contrast on light surface

graphics.chartStyle: flat 2D, minimal axis lines, accent color fills, dark or light background to match mode
graphics.illustrationStyle: photorealistic only — no flat vector, no isometric, no cartoon
decorativeElements: product cards with subtle border and 8px corner radius
W&W monogram (channel_avatar_light/dark) as sole brand mark in full-bleed photo compositions — wordmark PNGs with 'store' element deprecated 2026-05-26
graphics.dataLabelStyle: Inter SemiBold, accent color for key numbers, Graphite for secondary
graphics.cardStyle: background #F5F0EB or #EDE0D0 (light) / #1A1A1A (dark), border 1px #D4C9BC, 8px corner radius, 24–40px padding
graphics.imageComposition: split layout (text left 40% / visual right 60%) or full-bleed with minimal text overlay

priority3: Multiple glasses in one frame — standing, with shadows, at angle
Bottle + glass(es) together — bar worktop, casual arrangement
Light and shadow play through glass — geometric shadow patterns on surface
Hands / forearms holding glass or bottle — no face
Pour — wine flowing into glass, frozen motion
priority2: Torso / shoulder / silhouette with glass — no face, from behind or below
priority1: Details: cork, label, neck, condensation, drop on glass

principles: Odd number of objects (3 glasses, 5 bottles)
Varying heights and distances — depth of scene
Allowed 'live disorder': bottle on side, corks on table, glass slightly shifted
No object perfectly symmetrical to another
forbidden: Faces or eye contact with camera
Restaurant table setting — cutlery, napkin folds, place settings

hand.allowed: wrist and palm, neutral or no manicure

forearm.allowed: cropped above elbow, shirt sleeve or bare

shoulder.allowed: from behind or side, no face visible

multipleHands.allowed: different hands holding glasses — top or side view

visual.language: English only — Phuket is international resort. Wine/whiskey names in original language.

statement.compositionHint: Text dominant left/center, photo cropped bottom-right corner only

moment.compositionHint: 100% full-bleed action photo, logo only in bottom-right corner

info_card.compositionHint: 2-column: photo left 50%, text right 50%, CTA strip bottom

price_arrival.compositionHint: Large price/number center-top (Bebas Neue), bottle center, name+origin bottom

web_hero.compositionHint: Text left 45%, lifestyle photo right 55%, light background, bold headline

web_product_grid.compositionHint: 3-column product card grid, cream cards, W&W placeholder, clean labels below
web_product_grid.visualZone: inside each card — product image 1:1 aspect

monogram.usage: Sole brand mark across all materials — social, decks, B2B, print, web.

wordmark.reason: All current PNG wordmarks (logo_black*, logo_white*, logo_color*, logo_sq_color*, logo_sq_black*, logo_sq_white*) still contain the legacy 'store' element between WINE and & WHISKEY. Do not use until clean files are regenerated.
wordmark.fallback: If a text logo is genuinely required, set 'Wine & Whiskey' by hand in Bebas Neue UPPERCASE — no 'store' or any other word between WINE and & WHISKEY.

forbidden: Using any deprecated wordmark PNG that contains 'store'
Adding any subscript/word between WINE and & WHISKEY
Recoloring, distorting, adding shadow or outline to the monogram

brand.name: Wine & Whiskey
brand.concept: Urban wine bar and store. Neighborhood. Comes in a suit after work and jeans on Saturday.
brand.voiceOneLiner: A friend with good taste who doesn't lecture.

registers.direct: New arrival, product fact — 'Rioja Reserva. Dark cherry, some oak. In stock now.'
registers.calm: Story, recommendation — 'Malbec from Mendoza — a wine that doesn't try to prove anything.'
registers.light: Friday, occasion, mood — 'A good Friday starts with choosing the bottle.'
registers.expert: Region, producer, vintage — '2019 — one of the best years for Barolo in the last decade.'
